caption:
The video captures a dance studio with white walls, a wall-mounted air-conditioner, track lights, and a full-height mirror wall on the right. A woman with a dark ponytail, neon-yellow tank top, white flared skirt, neon-yellow leg warmers and white sneakers stands center stage seen mostly from behind, her front-facing reflection on the right. Her right arm lifts from a side position and rises through a bent phase near the head. It then reaches a near-vertical overhead extension, index finger pointing up.

The right arm bends back down toward the head and lowers while the left arm remains at the side. As the arms settle, her torso rotates from the back-facing stance into a right-side profile, the skirt swaying with the shift. From the side profile the right arm extends toward the mirror, then raises again with the index finger pointing up. She holds the raised position while her weight shifts and feet reposition slightly.

The raised arm bends down as both arms flex in front of the chest, the mirror reproducing every change as a single mirrored dancer.
